主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by the Royal Bank of Canada, published on January 9, 2014. It is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes an exhibit titled 'Director Independence Policy,' which outlines the bank's policy regarding the independence of its directors. The filing is submitted in accordance with Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(7), and it is signed by Carol J. McNamara, who holds the title of Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary. The document is part of the bank's regulatory filings and provides information on its governance practices.
